changelog: New voice command: say 'checkbox' or 'check box' (or 'চেকবক্স' / 'টিক বক্স') alone while dictating and a new line with a checkbox ☐ starts — handy for a packing or todo checklist without typing every ☐ by hand. With Spoken Punctuation on, 'checkbox' and 'checkbox sign' also work mid-sentence. Undo removes just the box (76 commands in Help & Support > Voice commands). Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
